title: CppCon 2018: Hana Dusíková “Compile Time Regular Expressions”
summary: Hana Dusikova's CppCon 2018 talk presenting a C++ library that builds regular expressions from compile-time strings, using a C++20 feature. It avoids runtime parsing cost and covers implementation details, problems she hit, and benchmarks.
why: Pointed to as the canonical presentation of compile-time regex in C++ and its template metaprogramming, including benchmark results.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: A 54:47 presentation at CppCon 2018 is worth more than a thousand words
